data.name: Carbon Cycle
data.description: Carbon Cycle GmbH & Co. KG is a biochar producer based in Rieden, Bavaria, Germany, making Pflanzenkohle from PEFC-certified untreated wood chips via pyrolysis for agricultural soil improvement and animal feed applications. The company is EBC-certified and Puro.earth-listed with CORC 100+ durability; it started biochar production in 2019 and commissioned a second, larger production system in 2023.
